title: Stop Applying to Jobs — DM Your Way Into Companies
audience: 18-28 year olds job hunting, LinkedIn users
tone: High energy, direct, slightly rebellious, practical

concept.hook: I never applied to a single job after my second year. Every opportunity came from a DM.
concept.story_arc: Hook → Why DMs work → The template → Timing → CTA

shots.prompt: Vertical. Person on couch, typing on LinkedIn, cup of coffee beside them. Phone screen shows a DM thread — the reply notification pops: 'Let's schedule a call.' Eyes widen. Slow smile. They sit up straight.
shots.narration: I never applied to a single job after my second year. Every opportunity came from a DM.
shots.sfx: LinkedIn notification sound, chair squeak, excited ambient

shots.prompt: Vertical infographic animation. Text appearing line by line: '70% of jobs are never posted.' 'The hidden job market = 2/3 of all hiring.' Arrows pointing from hidden pool to filled positions. Animated contrast: pile of rejected resumes vs one successful DM.
shots.narration: Seventy percent of jobs are never posted publicly. The hidden job market is accessed through relationships, not resumes. DMs work because 95% of candidates don't send them. When everyone else is uploading their resume into a black hole, you're standing out because you're a human — not a PDF.
shots.sfx: Data reveal animation sounds, notification ping

shots.prompt: Vertical. Close-up phone screen showing LinkedIn DM being typed. Three-part template animates as it's typed: Part 1: 'Specific compliment on their work.' Part 2: 'Genuine question about their process.' Part 3: 'One sentence about what you bring.' All three highlighted. Clock overlay shows 'Sent: Tuesday 10:30am'.
shots.camera: [Push in] Zoom into phone screen as DM is typed
shots.narration: The template: specific compliment on their work, genuine question about their process, one sentence about what you bring. Three sentences. That's it. And timing matters — message decision-makers Tuesday through Thursday, 10am to noon. Higher response rate than mass outreach.
shots.sfx: Keyboard typing sounds, send button whoosh

shots.prompt: Vertical direct to camera. Confident energy, person sits forward. Hand gestures. Follow button animation. Comment CTA.
shots.narration: Your resume gets you screened out. Your personality gets you hired in. Learn to communicate like a human. Drop a 'DM' in the comments if you want the full template. Follow for more career content.

📌 What you'll learn:
- Why 70% of jobs are never posted publicly
- The hidden job market and how to access it
- The 3-sentence DM template that gets responses
- Best timing: when to DM hiring managers

💬 Drop 'DM' in the comments for the full template.
